Security hardening for the inline preview added in v2.8.0.

## Security

- **Inline preview is now restricted to inert content types.** The preview
  (`?inline=1`) echoed the uploader-supplied content type with an `inline`
  disposition, so a crafted share could have rendered HTML or a scripted SVG on
  the app's own origin. Inline rendering is now allowlisted **server-side** to
  PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP and PDF — no SVG, no HTML — and sent with
  `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`. Anything else downloads as an attachment, as
  it always did. The download-limit and burn behaviour are unchanged.
